children.text: Tablets:
3x Irradiated tablets
You want "Map has 2 additional random map modifiers" and Monster effect or increased number of rares.
Item rarity is also okay, but worse than the other 2.
Cheaper/Easier tablets. Increased number of rares/monster effect or monster rarity (get 2 out of these 3 modifiers).
Will be worse for loot, but easier maps and way cheaper tablets, use these on non-aldur saga maps.
Waystone:
8 Mod waystones seem to be the best for loot. Aim for the highest monster effect. Monster rarity is also quite good, rarity is okay and pack size is bad.
T16 waystones can also be good, but pretty expensive and aren't needed anymore since you reach area lvl 81 with t15 maps in grand expeditions, meaning you still drop ilvl 82 exceptional bases.
Cheapest option is to make your own 70% effect waystones with 6 modifiers and corrupt after.
Atlas Master:
Jado: Unexpected Missions, Eastern Knowledhe, Partial Translations and KJeen appraisal.
Doryani is also viable, but I had more success running jado.
Unique maps/Boss Rumors:
Stardrinker/Origin of the fall/The last to fall/End of the Circle
are Boss Encounters.
All that glitters/reflective waters/almost paradise/a good fellow/Fallen skies
are Unique Maps.
Fallen Skies and Stardrinker:
Fallen Skies
is the one good unique map, as it'll guarantee a Perfect flux.
Stardrinker
will spawn uthred, which spawns a quest item that can only drop once per a character for runeseeker's call.
Best runes:
Keep in mind Runes do Not stack, so you want one of each
SS Tier
: Opulent (do note, if you have a 8-9 rune at the end with Opulent you can also end at that if you have no prolif ones).
S Tier
: Power, Death, and Bond
A Tier
: Time, Oath and rebirth (rebirth is the only blue rune on this list).
B Tier:
Rest of the purple runes (not important, can always reroll if it's 3-5 runes).
C Tier
: Rest of the blue runes

You also always want to keep good rewards of at least 3 Divines or higher, below that is up to you and depends on the map. (I'll keep 1-2 divine rewards if map doesn't look so great, as in it has a lot of bad runes).
How to run a grand expedition
s:

Essentially at the start of the expedition, you don't really care if your runes are 4-6, You want as many good runes as possible and towards the end you want a lot of 7+ rune combinations for max loot, but there is a lot of nuance here.
The one GG rune is Opulent, without this rune my loot is substantially worse and I usually rush towards this if it's on the map.

Do note on All 5, 6 or 7 maps you should reroll aggressively because your base can never be bad. Generally Always keep 7+ runes if it's near the end and always roll 5 runes at the start if it doesn't have any good purple runes.
Tablets:
1x freedom of faith (unique ritual tablet)
2x Ritual tablets with: Altars in Map allow rerolling Favours 3 additional times (try to get +1 modifier here)
1x Ritual tablet (get 2 modifiers here, cheap since it's not +3 rerolls)
Mandatory:
T15 6 mod map for lvl 79 area (you wont get good omens below lvl 79).
3 tablet modifiers you always want:
(spread across the 3 tablets) - Feel free to get 2x as any mod, only #1 is mandatory.
Rerolling favours at ritual altars in map cost 20-30% reduced tribute - This one is mandatory, if you only use one than you want a 28-30% roll.
Monsters Sacrificed at Ritual Altars in Map grant 18-30% increased Tribute
Ritual Favours in Map have 35-70% increased chance to be Omens
Deferring Favours at Ritual Altars in Map costs 20-30% reduced Tribute
Jado:
Partial translation and unforeseen threats - unexpected mission is also good.
Tablets:
1x abyss with "abyss pits in maps are twice as likely to have rewards"
1x abyss with "chance to contain 4 additional abyss pits"
1x abyss with any modifier (or overseer tablet for +1 rogue exile).
Note: Increased rarity of items found is also a good tablet modifier
Jado:
Partial translation and unforeseen threats - unexpected mission is also good.
Tablets: 4x breach tablets
3x with
"unstable breaches in map spawn 3 additional rare monsters when stabilized" (this mod rolls from 1-3, can divine yourself if it's cheaper).
1x unique breach tablet
- You want 5 additional rares here and preferable no negative packsize
Other good mods you want to get:
Try to get 2 out of these 3 - If you can only get one, than chose monster effectiveness.
1) "Monsters have 10-15% increased Effectiveness"
2) "5-20% increased Effectiveness of Rare Breach Monsters in Map"
3) "8-12% increased Rarity of Items found in Map"
Maps:
Have to run cities for 4 tablets and use a grand mirror for 200% deli on maps.
6-8 mod t15 waystone, you're looking for high item rarity and high monster effectiveness.
Master:
Jado
Partial translation, unforeseen threats and unexpected mission.
1st Strat:
Jado abyss
Tablets: 4x abyss (can replace 2 with other tablets for cheaper prices)
Mandatory tablet mods:
1x "Abyssal Monsters have #% increased Effectiveness for each closed Pit, up to 100%"
1x Map has #% chance to contain four additional Abysses
4x "Map has 2 additional random Modifier" (you need this on every tablet)
1x "#% increased chance for Abyssal monsters in Map to have Abyssal Modifiers" (seemd really good from testing, would always use 1, can use 2)
Not mandatory but the best mod after +2 map mods is "Map has #% increased number of Rare Monsters"
You want at least 3 modifier tablets, here are some other good modifiers you can get
1) pack size in map
2) monster rarity
3) rarity of items found
4) monster effectiveness (not as good in this strat because you already have so much)
5) abysses in map spawn increased monsters (not sure how good this stat is, but can't be bad)
Maps:
Have to run cities for 4 tablets and use a grand mirror for 200% deli on maps.
6-8 mod t15 waystone (can do t16, but doesn't make a difference in loot unless it pushes you to area lvl 81 for ilvl 82 gear, which requires +1 tablet).
Waystone:
6 mod your maps, Use "omen of chaotic effectiveness" (optional: also use chaotic quantity) and corrupt all.
Ideally you only run 8 mods, but thats a bit hard to sustain, so also run every good 6 mod map. Can run or sell your t16s.
Master:
Jado: Partial translation, unforeseen threats and unexpected mission.
2nd Strat:
Hilda (Take Breeding season and ancient inscriptions)
Tablets: 1x abyss, 1x irradiated, 1x overseer, 1x breach
(can also use abyss unique tablet over a rare one).
Abyss needs chance to contain four pits and effectiveness per pit closed.
Other 3 tablets all need "1-2 additional random map modifiers" and 2 other good modifiers
Not mandatory but the best mod after +2 map mods is "Map has #% increased number of Rare Monsters"
Other good mods:
1) pack size in map
2) monster rarity
3) rarity of items found
4) monster effectiveness (not as good in this strat because you already have so much)
use 3x tablets with "1-2 random map modifiers" (you want 2 if you can handle the difficulty)
Use 1 forest unique tablet - Optional: Use visions of paradise to run the map once
If you use visions of paradise, the map will stay as a forest for the 2nd run, so you can instead use 3x tablets with +2 random map modifiers.
Waystone drop chance(on the map) increases the drop chance of
Tablets: 3x delirium tablets (can alch and go or use specific modifiers to increase profits).
Good mods:
15-30% increased Stack size of Simulacrum Splinters found in Map
Delirium Encounters in Map are 15-30% more likely to spawn Unique Bosses
Not sure how good (if it increased the amount of rewards you get, it's good)
Delirium Fog in Map spawns 15-30% increased Fracturing Mirrors
Map objective:
Try to do all delirium reward tiles on the way to the boss.
Note: only end the delirium encounter after you kill the boss.
Waystone:
Just want a 6 mod waystone so you can run 3 tablets, you don't care for any modifier.
would recommend to corrupt and sell your T16s for bonus profit.
Need amanamu and omens selected on abyss tree.
Mandatory:
50% increased chance to find lineage gems in forest
After that you just need all the waystone/tablet effect modifiers.
